title: Introduce adaptive-lint-fence and graceful release-drain window for quieter rollouts
author: Maya Patel
description: Summary: Add an adaptive lint fence that dynamically gates heavy linters based on change-surface heuristics and lightweight fastpath presubmit prober to reduce CI noise; add a configurable release 'gentle drain' window that quiesces noncritical rollouts, migrates in-flight jobs, and emits clearer telemetry for release health. Motivation: large monorepo CI runtime and noisy long linters slow developer feedback and cause frequent merge blockers; releases sometimes spike transient errors when many canaries roll simultaneously. This PR introduces two complementary features to improve feedback velocity and stability. What changed: 1) CI presubmit: new lightweight prober (tools/presubmit/prober.go + .github/workflows/presubmit-prober.yml) pings impacted language shards and marks PRs eligible for fastpath when only metadata/docs/json changes are detected. 2) Adaptive lint fence: a new gating layer (tools/lint/fence/) that calculates a change-cost score (lines, files, languages, transitive dep churn) and selectively runs heavy linters/formatters only when cost exceeds thresholds. 3) Release gentle drain: release agents/scripts (scripts/release/drain.sh and infra/release/config.yml) implement a configurable window during which canary traffic is gradually reduced, flaky retry budgets are increased, and a 'release.quiesce' metric is emitted. 4) Toolchain and actions: updated GitHub Actions pinned versions and slimmed toolchain images (infra/ci/toolchain-manifests.json); bumped actions/checkout and setup-go, and upgraded the eslint plugin used by JS teams. 5) Docs and onboarding: ci/guide.md and docs/ci/release-gentle-drain.md added with examples and troubleshooting. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep full linting and existing release cadence unless teams opt into adaptive fence or enable release drain via team config. Migration plan: feature flags rolled out per-team over 2 weeks; CI metrics dashboards added for monitoring. Checklist: [x] Unit tests for prober and fence logic [x] End-to-end smoke in staging [x] Docs added [x] Linear tickets attached [x] Toolchain images built and uploaded Related: ENG-2123 (presubmit stability), ENG-2187 (release health), SUP-4321 (incident follow-up). Notes: lint-fence threshold config placed in .ci/lint-profiles/* and can be tuned without code changes. Observability: new metrics prefixed ci.presubmit.* and release.drain.* and new Grafana dashboard link in the PR (internal link). Rollout: staged by team via release-cfg, monitored for 72 hours after each enablement. Risk: misconfigured thresholds could hide real regressions; we added safeties: any presubmit that suppresses heavy linters will still run a lightweight regression eval and post a warning comment if high-risk patterns are detected. Merge method: squash and merge.
